intro.h2: Showers and bathrooms with a builder who listens
paragraphs: Turnmire Eco Construction handles bathroom remodels in Kettle Falls, and much of our work is the shower: tile walls with a built-in niche, a bench, a grab bar where you need it and a clean linear drain. Liam and his apprentice Chayse built one for a customer who praised the high quality workmanship and top notch work ethic.

Customers keep inviting us back. One family had us do a tile bathroom remodel, finish their attic with a new staircase and then redo a second small bathroom. Another has hired us for two remodels. They mention honest, straightforward advice and patience when they want to change things as the project takes shape.

services.h2: Bathroom remodel services in Kettle Falls

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: We take a tired bathroom down and rebuild it with new tile, a new shower, vanity and fixtures. One customer said their tile bathroom remodel turned out beautifully, and reviewers describe Liam as very thorough in his work from start to finish.

image.alt: Bathroom with a marble-look tile shower behind glass, a white vanity cabinet and a toilet

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: Our showers are built around how you use them: a recessed niche for bottles, a corner bench to sit on, a curved grab bar and a decorative tile band. Liam offers ideas along the way, and you decide what fits.

image.alt: Tile shower with a corner bench, curved stainless grab bar, recessed niche and diamond-pattern border tile

items.name: Shower floors and glass
items.blurb: A good shower floor drains fast and stays clean. We have built tiled shower floors with linear drains and fitted frameless glass enclosures that let the tile show from the doorway. Ask about a walk-in layout if you want an easier step in.

image.alt: Grey square tile shower floor with a long linear drain along one side

items.name: Attics, stairs and other remodels
items.blurb: Bathrooms are our focus, but not our limit. We have finished an attic and added a staircase, and taken on other remodel projects for repeat clients. If you have a construction challenge, Liam likes finding creative solutions.

items.title: Liam talks to you
items.text: Customers call Liam a great communicator and very thorough. You deal with the person building your bathroom, not a salesperson.

items.title: Ideas, not just labor
items.text: Reviewers say Liam provides excellent input and ideas and is creative at finding solutions to construction challenges, so your bathroom can be better than your first sketch.

items.title: Flexible when plans change
items.text: One client said Liam is super patient and flexible if you want to modify your project as you see it taking shape. Changing your mind mid-job is normal.

items.title: Finishes as planned
items.text: One customer wrote that the project progressed as anticipated and finished as planned. Two of our reviewers hired us for more than one project.

about.h2: About Liam Turnmire and his crew
about.text: Turnmire Eco Construction is Liam Turnmire's remodeling company on Moore Rd in Kettle Falls, Washington. Liam works on the jobs himself with his crew, including his apprentice Chayse. Our Google reviews go back eight years and describe Liam as honest, straightforward, creative and very thorough. One family said the crew was around for months on their projects and they actually kind of missed them when it was over. Most of our work is bathrooms and tile showers, along with attic finishing, stairs and other remodels for people who call us back.

image.alt: Tile shower wall with a recessed niche, diamond-pattern band and curved grab bar built by Liam and his apprentice

steps.title: Call Liam
steps.text: Call (509) 220-4367, Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM, and tell us about the bathroom and what you would like to change.

steps.title: Ideas and plan
steps.text: Liam looks at the space and offers ideas, like where a niche, bench or grab bar would help, then you agree on the plan together.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Liam and his crew handle the demolition, tile work and fixtures. You can adjust details as you see the room take shape.

steps.title: Finish and walk through
steps.text: We finish the job as planned and walk through the new bathroom with you, so you can check every detail.

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodels in Kettle Falls, WA
service_area.text: Turnmire Eco Construction is based at 3478-B Moore Rd in Kettle Falls, WA. We remodel bathrooms, build tile showers and take on other remodeling projects for homeowners in the area. If you are near Kettle Falls and want to know whether we can take on your project, call (509) 220-4367 during the week and tell us where your home is.

items.q: Can you add a bench, niche or grab bar to my shower?
items.a: Yes. Our shower photos include a recessed niche, a corner bench and a curved grab bar in the same shower, plus decorative tile bands. Liam can suggest where each would help, based on how you use the bathroom and who uses it.

items.q: Who will actually be working in my home?
items.a: Liam works on the job himself with his crew. On one shower the work was done by Liam and his apprentice Chayse. Customers mention that Liam communicates well and is very thorough, so you always know who to ask.

items.q: What if I want to change something mid-project?
items.a: That is fine. One client wrote that Liam is super patient and flexible if you want to modify your project as you see it taking shape. We talk through what the change involves and adjust the plan with you before going ahead.

Bathrooms and tile showers are our main work, but we have also finished an attic and added a staircase, and done other remodel projects for repeat clients. If your project is not a bathroom, call and describe it, and Liam will tell you if it is a fit.

We are open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends. Call (509) 220-4367 or email LiamTurnmire@gmail.com with a short description and a few photos of your bathroom to get started. Liam will get back to you during working hours.
